workflow.name: IOC hunt across the estate
workflow.description: When an IOC (IP, domain, URL, hash or file name) is added to a case, searches the SIEM for it over the last 30 days, counts the hits per host and, when hosts outside the case saw it, notifies the case owner and whoever added the IOC and suggests adding each of those hosts (up to 5, one a minute) to the case as an asset linked to the IOC. Written for Elasticsearch / OpenSearch with ECS fields: set the URL of the search node to your cluster and index, and adapt the query of the "SIEM query" node to another SIEM or EDR. Needs the keystore entry SIEM_API_KEY (an API key, restricted to the SIEM host) and, for an internal SIEM, IRIS_AI_WORKFLOWS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_EGRESS. For long searches, switch the request to async mode.

config.title: IOC {{ nodes.prepare.output.result.value | truncate(60) }} seen on {{ nodes.hits.output.result.new_count }} host(s) outside the case
config.body:
Case #{{ trigger.entity_id }}: the SIEM saw this IOC in {{ nodes.hits.output.result.total_hits }} event(s) over the last {{ nodes.prepare.output.result.days }} days, on {{ nodes.hits.output.result.hosts }} host(s), {{ nodes.hits.output.result.new_count }} of them not in the case. Adding them is suggested in the case.

{{ nodes.hits.output.result.table }}

config.title: Add {{ nodes.pick.output.result.host.host | truncate(80) }} to the case: it saw IOC {{ nodes.prepare.output.result.value | truncate(60) }}
config.body:
**{{ nodes.pick.output.result.host.host }}** is not an asset of this case, but the SIEM saw IOC `{{ nodes.prepare.output.result.value }}` ({{ nodes.prepare.output.result.kind }}) on it in {{ nodes.pick.output.result.host.hits }} event(s) over the last {{ nodes.prepare.output.result.days }} days; last seen {{ nodes.pick.output.result.host.last_seen | default("unknown", true) }}.

Accept to add it to the case as an asset linked to the IOC, then check the events on the SIEM: a hit may be a block, a scan or a lookup rather than a compromise.
